skill.name: figma-automation
skill.description: Automate Figma file inspection, exports, design tokens, comments, and team browsing through the Rube MCP Figma toolkit.
skill.summary: Use Rube MCP tools to inspect Figma designs, export assets, extract tokens, and manage comments.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around MCP tool names, parameters, and example workflow fences. The only confirmed issue is the documented third-party Rube MCP endpoint, which creates a low-risk network and OAuth trust boundary for Figma data.

remediation.suggestion: Document that rube.app/mcp is a third-party service and list the Figma data and OAuth scopes it may access.
Require explicit user confirmation before adding comments or performing downloads through the connected Figma account.
Default examples should request narrow node IDs and limited depth before reading broad Figma files.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Figma connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `figma`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- `file_key`: File key from URL (e.g., 'abc123XYZ' from figma.com/design/abc123XYZ/...)
- `depth`: Tree traversal depth (2 for pages and top-level children)
- `simplify`: True for AI-friendly format (70%+ size reduction)
- `ids` must be a comma-separated string, not an array
- Response data may be in `data_preview` instead of `data`
- `images`: Array of {node_id, file_name, format} for downloads
- `tokens`: Full tokens object from extraction (for Tailwind conversion)
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
2. Extract file_key, node_id, team_id from response

content.user_title: Automate Figma Workflows with Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Figma handoff often needs repeated file inspection, exports, and token extraction. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP Figma workflows.
actual_capabilities: Connects to the Rube MCP Figma toolkit and checks available tool schemas before workflow steps.
Discovers Figma file, node, team, and project identifiers from user-provided URLs.
Retrieves file JSON, node details, components, component sets, styles, comments, and version history.
Renders selected nodes as PNG, SVG, JPG, or PDF assets and can download generated images.
Extracts design tokens and can convert token data into Tailwind configuration guidance.
Lists team projects, project files, team styles, and published design system resources.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Figma connection authorized by the user.
Only Figma Design files are supported; FigJam and Slides are not supported by the documented flow.
Large file reads can exceed payload limits unless node IDs and depth are narrowed.
Rendered image URLs are temporary and may expire after about 30 days.

use_cases.title: Audit a Component Library
use_cases.description: Inspect a design file, list components and component sets, and summarize coverage gaps for a design system review.

use_cases.title: Prepare Design Tokens for Build
use_cases.description: Extract colors, typography, spacing, and variables, then prepare token data for Tailwind implementation.

use_cases.title: Review Design Feedback
use_cases.description: Collect comments, reactions, and version history from a Figma file before a product review meeting.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a Figma File
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the figma-automation skill to inspect this Figma design URL: [URL]. Find pages, top-level frames, and available components. Do not modify the file.

prompt_templates.title: Export Selected Frames
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the figma-automation skill to render these node IDs from [URL] as PNG assets at scale 2. Confirm the node ID format before rendering.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Tokens for Tailwind
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the figma-automation skill to extract colors, typography, spacing, local styles, and variables from [URL]. Prepare a Tailwind conversion summary.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Team Design Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the figma-automation skill to review team projects, project files, published styles, and component sets from [TEAM OR PROJECT URL]. Report gaps and duplicates.

output_examples.input: Inspect this Figma design and list component sets.
output_examples.output: A concise overview of pages, top-level frames, component sets, and any unsupported or oversized sections.

output_examples.input: Export these three frames as SVG assets.
output_examples.output: A render summary with node names, output format, temporary asset links, and any failed node renders.

output_examples.input: Extract design tokens and prepare Tailwind guidance.
output_examples.output: A token summary covering color roles, typography scales, spacing values, sources, and Tailwind conversion notes.

best_practices: Start with URL discovery and schema search before choosing a Figma tool.
Request narrow node IDs and low depth before expanding large file reads.
Confirm user intent before adding comments, downloading assets, or browsing team resources.
anti_patterns: Passing node IDs as arrays when the documented tools expect comma-separated strings.
Fetching whole files at high depth before identifying the relevant nodes.
Using temporary render URLs as permanent production asset links.

faq.question: Does this skill need Figma API keys?
faq.answer: No direct API key is documented. It needs Rube MCP and user authorization for Figma.

faq.question: Can this skill modify Figma files?
faq.answer: The documented write action is adding comments. Confirm user approval before any write action.

faq.question: Does it support FigJam or Slides?
faq.answer: No. The documented file workflow supports Figma Design files only.

faq.question: Can it export images from Figma?
faq.answer: Yes. It can render selected nodes as PNG, SVG, JPG, or PDF through the Rube MCP tools.

faq.question: Can it help with Tailwind design tokens?
faq.answer: Yes. It can extract tokens and use the documented Tailwind conversion workflow.

faq.question: What data may pass through Rube MCP?
faq.answer: Figma URLs, file metadata, node data, comments, rendered assets, and token data may pass through the external MCP service.
